premise: Back from a drive, the buggy and Robo-dog are grey with clingy moon dust; Engineer brushes, Robo-dog shakes like a wet dog — and the dust goes everywhere.
inspiration: Grimm's 'The Elves and the Shoemaker' (the helpers who tidy in the night), turned: the helper makes the mess, and the mess makes the fun.
lesson: Helping doesn't have to be perfect to be kind.

en-US.title: The Dust That Stuck
en-US.text: {buggy:enter} The buggy came rolling back from a long drive, {robodog:enter} with Robo-dog trotting alongside. {robodog:face happy} Both of them were grey from top to bottom. Moon dust! It sticks to everything, and gets in everywhere. {engineer:enter} {engineer:face surprised} Look at you two, sighed Engineer. {engineer:go to buggy} She grabbed a brush and {engineer:live} scrubbed the buggy's wheels. Scrub, scrub, scrub. Robo-dog wanted to help. So he did what dogs do. {canvas:dust 5s} {robodog:shake 0.9} He shook himself from nose to tail. {sfx:shake} Dust flew everywhere… {engineer:face sad} all over Engineer. [pause] {astronaut:enter} {astronaut:face happy} Astronaut burst out laughing. [laughs] {buggy:live} The buggy spun its wheels, just to join in. {robodog:live} Robo-dog sat up, very proud. {engineer:face happy} So they all brushed each other, {all:hop} and by bedtime everyone was clean. [giggles] Almost.

es-ES.title: El polvo pegajoso
es-ES.text: {buggy:enter} El buggy volvió rodando de un paseo muy largo, {robodog:enter} con Perro robot trotando a su lado. {robodog:face happy} Los dos estaban grises de arriba abajo. ¡Polvo lunar! Se pega a todo y se mete por todas partes. {engineer:enter} {engineer:face surprised} Pero mirad cómo venís, suspiró Ingeniera. {engineer:go to buggy} Cogió un cepillo y {engineer:live} frotó las ruedas del buggy. Frota, frota, frota. Perro robot quiso ayudar. Así que hizo lo que hacen los perros. {canvas:dust 5s} {robodog:shake 0.9} Se sacudió del hocico a la cola. {sfx:shake} El polvo voló por todas partes… {engineer:face sad} encima de Ingeniera. [pause] {astronaut:enter} {astronaut:face happy} Astronauta se partió de risa. [laughs] {buggy:live} El buggy hizo girar las ruedas, para apuntarse. {robodog:live} Perro robot se sentó, muy orgulloso. {engineer:face happy} Así que se cepillaron unos a otros, {all:hop} y a la hora de dormir todos estaban limpios. [giggles] Casi.

shake.prompt: a small robot dog shaking itself fast, rattly metal joints and a whoosh of dry dust, comic
